_comment: Copy this to accounts.json (GITIGNORED) to hold MULTIPLE named accounts per platform for the hub's <prefix>_account_* tools. env values may be literal secrets OR ${ENV} references resolved from the hub's environment at spawn time. Prefer ${ENV} refs so this file stays secret-free. Env-mode platforms: runpod, kaggle, modal, lightning, rclone. CLI-mode platforms (azure, gcloud) need NO entries here -- their accounts are the CLI's own profiles (az subscriptions / gcloud configurations) and are managed live via the az_/gc_ account tools. If a platform is omitted and its registration env vars are present, the hub seeds a single in-memory 'default' account automatically.
